run_copy_aligned_text: pipe aligned text lines into this script to prepend zero-padded utterance IDs
run_stdin_utterance_prefix: run the script with stdin input to prefix each line with a sequential utterance ID
run_kaldi_aligned_text_renumber: use this script to renumber Kaldi aligned text lines with formatted utterance IDs
run_wav2vec_self_train_text_prep: prepare self-training text data by adding utterance IDs via stdin piping
run_aligned_text_id_formatting: format aligned text output by prepending zero-padded utterance identifiers to each line
